# Portable GitHub skills

> Five focused Agent Skills for evidence-based GitHub work, portable between
> Codex and Claude Code. They are Markdown, so a clone is the whole
> installation; the repository checks are a Rust command in `tools/github-skills`.

`skills/` is the canonical source, loaded by Claude Code through the plugin
manifest (`claude --plugin-dir .`). The
tracked Codex copy in `.agents/skills/` is byte-identical to it and is
regenerated rather than edited. Every skill inspects and prepares local
work; none of them carries authority to push, open a pull request or release,
change GitHub settings, or make any other remote mutation.

## Skills

- [github-repository-audit](https://github.com/ryanduguid/github-agent-skills/blob/main/skills/github-repository-audit/SKILL.md): assess whether a repository is trustworthy, maintainable, presentable, or ready to feature.
- [github-readme-polish](https://github.com/ryanduguid/github-agent-skills/blob/main/skills/github-readme-polish/SKILL.md): improve a README's clarity, quick start, credibility, and badges without overstating repository evidence.
- [github-profile-curator](https://github.com/ryanduguid/github-agent-skills/blob/main/skills/github-profile-curator/SKILL.md): select profile projects, refine the profile README narrative, review pins, and prepare portfolio-facing copy.
- [github-release-prep](https://github.com/ryanduguid/github-agent-skills/blob/main/skills/github-release-prep/SKILL.md): assess release readiness, reconcile version drift, and prepare an evidence-backed tag, release, or publication handoff.
- [github-issue-to-pr](https://github.com/ryanduguid/github-agent-skills/blob/main/skills/github-issue-to-pr/SKILL.md): turn an issue into a narrow, tested local change with a commit and pull-request handoff.

## Install

- [Repository checks](https://github.com/ryanduguid/github-agent-skills#repository-checks): clone the repository, run the unit suite, then run the strict validator.
- Claude Code plugin: `claude plugin marketplace add ryanduguid/github-agent-skills`, then `claude plugin install github-agent-skills@ryanduguid-github-skills`. It installs `main`; the version comes from `.claude-plugin/plugin.json`.
- Codex plugin: `codex plugin marketplace add ryanduguid/github-agent-skills`, then `codex plugin add github-agent-skills@ryanduguid-github-skills`.
- One skill from the latest tagged release: `gh skill install ryanduguid/github-agent-skills <skill>`; add `--agent github-copilot` for GitHub Copilot.
- Copy instead: `.agents/skills/<skill>` into a project's Codex skill discovery path, or `skills/<skill>` into its Claude Code path.
- These skills are not automated pull request reviewers; for a review of a diff, use Copilot code review or the agent's own review command.
- Install only the runtime you use, and keep `skills/` as the source of truth for any local edit.

## Recorded runs

- [validation/baselines](https://github.com/ryanduguid/github-agent-skills/tree/main/validation/baselines): the no-skill control run for each of the five scenarios.
- [validation/forward](https://github.com/ryanduguid/github-agent-skills/tree/main/validation/forward): the named-skill run for the same scenarios.
- [tests/scenarios](https://github.com/ryanduguid/github-agent-skills/tree/main/tests/scenarios): the scenario prompt and evaluator rubric behind each pair.

Each recorded file lists the scenario and rubric revision, the Codex CLI version
(`codex-cli 0.151.0-alpha.7.2`), the isolation flags, a PASS or FAIL for every
rubric criterion, the SHA-256 digest of the retained raw output, and the exit
status. The controls fail 4 criteria in total and the named-skill runs pass
every criterion, though the release-prep pair is non-discriminating because both
of its runs pass. The files record those runs; they do not promise that a rerun
reproduces them. Results apply only to the skill files a run used: new run
files record a skill digest covering every file in the skill directory, and
`github-skills validate-skills --strict` fails when that digest no longer
matches. The current files predate the digest and are listed as having none.
